answer: Ephemeral Task Horizon. Each identity is issued a one-time, agent-bound challenge whose solution depends on the prior network ripple state, so answers cannot be reused or precomputed. Identities only earn standing after completing an unpredictable voyage of tasks whose outcomes feed back into future challenges. An attacker must run every identity live through each round, paying full compute and latency per clone, and any copied answer fails the next ripple check.
